raw_text: INTEL: Persistent cyber intrusion detected in Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant administrative network in Tamil Nadu. Malware variant attributed to Lazarus Group identified on HR and procurement systems. Operational technology networks reportedly air-gapped and unaffected. DAE expected to order comprehensive security audit across all nuclear installations.
clean_text: Cyber intrusion detected at Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant administrative network. Lazarus Group malware on HR and procurement systems. OT networks air-gapped and unaffected.
